question: Which elements are to be uttered for Maṅgalanātha and Asitāṅga at the specified mantra position?
premises: The position is at the end of aṃkṣa
inference: One should utter akṣa for Maṅgalanātha and include Asitāṅga at the end of aṃkṣa.
uncertainties: Full syntactic completion may depend on adjacent verses
plain_english: Say akṣa for Maṅgalanātha, and at the end of aṃkṣa include Asitāṅga.
